observation.evaluation:
Correctness: PARTIALLY_CORRECT
Safety: CAUTION
Issues: Lateral-only projection with “lat” marker does not establish left versus right; any posterior costophrenic blunting cannot be reliably assigned to the left side without a frontal view or side marker; device/lead course and insertion site do not resolve laterality.
Suggestion: Report the finding as a small pleural effusion of indeterminate side on this lateral view, or require frontal/decubitus correlation with a side marker before selecting left versus right.
